sponsorships.title: $1,000 per month
sponsorships.fullDescription:
### Fellow 3D artists! 👋

Since 2017 I've been working on Ucupaint, a free and open source Blender addon that can help you a lot with the material creation. As for September 2025, Ucupaint has been downloaded almost 200k across the [Blender Extension Platform](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/ucupaint/) and [GitHub](https://github.com/ucupumar/ucupaint/releases), and the number is still going up!

### Why sponsor me? 🙋

You can check out my plans on [the roadmap](https://ucupumar.github.io/ucupaint-wiki/roadmaps/). I really want to help level up the open‑source texturing ecosystem. Sponsors also get Ucupaint Plus with extra features, and if funding goes well, those features will be gradually released to everyone. 🙏
